The '''Analysis Bureau''' was a department of [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]].

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] was contacted by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]]. Tagge was enlisted, along with the foremost technical minds in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], to chair a specialized technology-based committee within the Analysis Bureau. The [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] was giving the Separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] the technological edge in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and Isard sought to bridge the gap by assembling the Republic's own technological geniuses. It was Tagge's job to oversee the development of new initiatives that would match, or surpass those of the Confederacy. He made news with the appointment, making a public statement from the city of [[Unlos Tagge]].
